data.title: iQmetrix to Deliver 2026 Telecom Industry Address and Product Announcements, Unveiling the Next Wave of Intelligent Commerce
data.description: In Vancouver, British Columbia, iQmetrix, a leading global provider of Intelligent Commerce Operating Systems for the telecom industry, has announced the opening of registration for the 2026 Telecom Industry Address and Product Announcements event. Scheduled for Wednesday, October 28, 2026, this year's event marks the first time iQmetrix will host two virtual sessions - one tailored for European participants and another for its traditional North American audience. These sessions are free to attend and will be the seventh year that the event has been held.

data.title: 18 state attorneys general oppose the CLARITY Act ahead of key Senate vote, citing concerns about weakened state oversight.
data.description: A recent development saw former President Trump make a significant concession regarding ethics, addressing a key obstacle in the passage of the crypto bill. However, 18 state attorneys general have expressed concerns, stating that the amended legislation could potentially undermine state supervision. This news highlights the complex interplay between federal and state authorities in regulating cryptocurrencies, underscoring the various challenges and considerations involved in crafting effective regulatory frameworks.

data.title: Archer® Launches a Harnessed Digital Workforce for GRC, Grounded in 492 Purpose-Built Models: Archer Evolv™ Foundation and Archer Evolv™ Workplace
data.description: Archer® has introduced Archer Evolv™ Foundation and Archer Evolv™ Workplace in Overland Park, Kan. These new offerings allow for the introduction of a controlled digital workforce into established enterprise GRC systems. Archer Evolv Foundation serves as the central AI intelligence layer that ensures each Operator remains within existing controls and permissions. On the other hand, Archer Evolv Workplace provides customers with a platform to choose and assign regulated AI Operators to their workflows. This innovation serves to enhance operational efficiency and productivity within businesses, signaling a significant move in the integration of AI technologies.
